cues.text: My lord, there is wet paper stuck to the throne again.
cues.line: [Goldin|Flustered]: My lord, there is wet paper stuck to the throne again.

cues.text: Pond Return Demand number 37, you know.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Deadpan]: Pond Return Demand number 37, you know.

cues.text: This is MY castle!
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Indignant]: This is MY castle!

cues.text: Then call me a tenant. I'll pay rent by guarding the bridge, you know.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Firm]: Then call me a tenant. I'll pay rent by guarding the bridge, you know.

cues.text: Before rent, consider this royal notice to fill the waterway.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Before rent, consider this royal notice to fill the waterway.

cues.text: They want to dump dirt in my pond, you know. I would not even take them as tenants.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Determined]: They want to dump dirt in my pond, you know. I would not even take them as tenants.

cues.text: Then every drop shall enjoy the protection of my majesty!
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Then every drop shall enjoy the protection of my majesty!

cues.text: Then lift your cloak, please. You are mopping my living room, you know.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Deadpan]: Then lift your cloak, please. You are mopping my living room, you know.

cues.text: If Nia crosses, I will stop her with my tongue. Just her feet, not her coins.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Determined]: If Nia crosses, I will stop her with my tongue. Just her feet, not her coins.

cues.text: If you can catch coins too, we should have another interview.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: If you can catch coins too, we should have another interview.

cues.text: The guest who left the entrance three days ago has just arrived.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: The guest who left the entrance three days ago has just arrived.

cues.text: Um... any... rooms... here...?
cues.line: [Neurit|Breathless]: Um... any... rooms... here...?

cues.text: You walked for three days? This castle needs that persistence!
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Moved]: You walked for three days? This castle needs that persistence!

cues.text: Upkeep is 1 food a day. Very reasonable, considering the walking speed.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Upkeep is 1 food a day. Very reasonable, considering the walking speed.

cues.text: I have… a house… but nowhere… to come back to…
cues.line: [Neurit|Whispering]: I have… a house… but nowhere… to come back to…

cues.text: Then come back here. I still have two pages of welcome speech left.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Then come back here. I still have two pages of welcome speech left.

cues.text: You should arrive well before the speech ends.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: You should arrive well before the speech ends.

cues.text: For once… I am… early…
cues.line: [Neurit|Happy]: For once… I am… early…

cues.text: I will leave… a trail… by the traps… Family… take the side…
cues.line: [Neurit|Determined]: I will leave… a trail… by the traps… Family… take the side…

cues.text: Got it. You lay it down, I heat it. Your house stays unroasted.
cues.line: [Pynn|Confident]: Got it. You lay it down, I heat it. Your house stays unroasted.

cues.text: My resume! Experience: 40 years guarding bridges!
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Pleading]: My resume! Experience: 40 years guarding bridges!

cues.text: Your reason for leaving was "the bridge got too sturdy."
cues.line: [Bati|Checking]: Your reason for leaving was "the bridge got too sturdy."

cues.text: This bridge... this bridge looks ready to fall apart! It needs me!
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Teary]: This bridge... this bridge looks ready to fall apart! It needs me!

cues.text: I'm unsure whether that's praise or an insult. You're hired.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Conflicted]: I'm unsure whether that's praise or an insult. You're hired.

cues.text: I thought losing my post meant I would not need a name anymore.
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Tearful]: I thought losing my post meant I would not need a name anymore.

cues.text: Here you are Beongbeong. Even a stronger bridge will not change that.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Determined]: Here you are Beongbeong. Even a stronger bridge will not change that.

cues.text: Please cry toward the water. Reissuing wet paperwork costs money.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Please cry toward the water. Reissuing wet paperwork costs money.

cues.text: Yes! Even my tears will report to their assigned post!
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Happy]: Yes! Even my tears will report to their assigned post!

cues.text: Those are big shields. They still cannot cross my bridge!
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Determined]: Those are big shields. They still cannot cross my bridge!

cues.text: Stand with the bridge. Do not collapse on its behalf.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Stand with the bridge. Do not collapse on its behalf.

cues.text: ...Did someone just say "hello" behind me?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Startled]: ...Did someone just say "hello" behind me?

cues.text: Were you scared...?
cues.line: [Shh|Whispering]: Were you scared...?

cues.text: Not at all! A Demon Lord knows no fear!
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Not at all! A Demon Lord knows no fear!

cues.text: ...Then can I keep practicing here?
cues.line: [Shh|Dejected]: ...Then can I keep practicing here?

cues.text: The greeting behind him worked. His lordship dropped his cup twice.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: The greeting behind him worked. His lordship dropped his cup twice.

cues.text: Then… is my place… behind someone too?
cues.line: [Shh|Whispering]: Then… is my place… behind someone too?

cues.text: Front or back, you have a place here. Just avoid the spot beneath my cup.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Front or back, you have a place here. Just avoid the spot beneath my cup.

cues.text: I will… catch the cup. After some practice…
cues.line: [Shh|Happy]: I will… catch the cup. After some practice…

cues.text: When the investigator turns… I will slip behind…
cues.line: [Shh|Determined]: When the investigator turns… I will slip behind…

cues.text: Remember whom to frighten. I have already clocked in.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Remember whom to frighten. I have already clocked in.

cues.text: Halt, wicked Demon Lord! In the name of justice, I shall...
cues.line: [Teongteong|Righteous]: Halt, wicked Demon Lord! In the name of justice, I shall...

cues.text: You just signed an employment contract with the castle.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: You just signed an employment contract with the castle.

cues.text: ...Lord Wicked Demon, what are my working hours?
cues.line: [Teongteong|Flustered]: ...Lord Wicked Demon, what are my working hours?

cues.text: In front of the throne. The most heroic post in the castle.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Pleased]: In front of the throne. The most heroic post in the castle.

cues.text: If Leon sees me… he will call me an empty suit playing hero.
cues.line: [Teongteong|Flustered]: If Leon sees me… he will call me an empty suit playing hero.

cues.text: Who checks how full you are when you guard the family behind me?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Determined]: Who checks how full you are when you guard the family behind me?

cues.text: Do empty the rainwater, though. You slosh when you walk.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Do empty the rainwater, though. You slosh when you walk.

cues.text: I shall begin with a righteous draining!
cues.line: [Teongteong|Happy]: I shall begin with a righteous draining!

cues.text: Leon is coming… I may not know justice, but I know the names behind me.
cues.line: [Teongteong|Determined]: Leon is coming… I may not know justice, but I know the names behind me.

cues.text: Protect those first. Leave the rest of the speech to me.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Protect those first. Leave the rest of the speech to me.

cues.text: I shall bring light to this den of darkness.
cues.line: [Selen|Solemn]: I shall bring light to this den of darkness.

cues.text: We already HAVE a lighting expert! Two hundred years of candle experience!
cues.line: [Noknok|Indignant]: We already HAVE a lighting expert! Two hundred years of candle experience!

cues.text: The candle has walked off its candlestick. I'll handle the personnel forms.
cues.line: [Bati|Recording]: The candle has walked off its candlestick. I'll handle the personnel forms.

cues.text: AAH, a drip! ...Anyway, nice to meet you!
cues.line: [Noknok|Screaming]: AAH, a drip! ...Anyway, nice to meet you!

cues.text: Two hundred years? Does that make you my senior?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Two hundred years? Does that make you my senior?

cues.text: Then give your senior a roof! That drip just looked at me!
cues.line: [Noknok|Fear]: Then give your senior a roof! That drip just looked at me!

cues.text: A roof for a candle is a new expense. The ledger seems shy about it.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: A roof for a candle is a new expense. The ledger seems shy about it.

cues.text: It is my first time walking out too! The ledger and I can adjust together!
cues.line: [Noknok|Happy]: It is my first time walking out too! The ledger and I can adjust together!

cues.text: I may not outshine Selen, but I will light our home!
cues.line: [Noknok|Determined]: I may not outshine Selen, but I will light our home!

cues.text: Keep the career history brief and the drip alerts precise.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Keep the career history brief and the drip alerts precise.

cues.text: Gob found something in the dirt! A mole in a hard hat!
cues.line: [Gob|Boasting]: Gob found something in the dirt! A mole in a hard hat!

cues.text: Rescued, not found. Safety first!
cues.line: [Papa|Firm]: Rescued, not found. Safety first!

cues.text: Former kingdom engineer, then. Do you know their construction schedule?
cues.line: [Bati|Checking]: Former kingdom engineer, then. Do you know their construction schedule?

cues.text: More than that. I know exactly which bits are shoddy.
cues.line: [Papa|Grinning]: More than that. I know exactly which bits are shoddy.

cues.text: When the tunnel fell, my royal coworkers pretended not to hear my name.
cues.line: [Papa|Checking]: When the tunnel fell, my royal coworkers pretended not to hear my name.

cues.text: Gob heard! Gob dug where the voice was!
cues.line: [Gob|Grinning]: Gob heard! Gob dug where the voice was!

cues.text: Next time, supports first! We cannot bury the rescuer too!
cues.line: [Papa|Determined]: Next time, supports first! We cannot bury the rescuer too!

cues.text: Good. Our first safety rule is that Gob comes home too.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Good. Our first safety rule is that Gob comes home too.

cues.text: Roman checks the supports first. We check beneath our family first!
cues.line: [Papa|Determined]: Roman checks the supports first. We check beneath our family first!

cues.text: Got it! Look beside me before punching the ground!
cues.line: [Gob|Grinning]: Got it! Look beside me before punching the ground!

cues.text: This map has three thrones marked on it?
cues.line: [Milo|Flustered]: This map has three thrones marked on it?

cues.text: All three are right! ...Probably!
cues.line: [Kkogit|Confident]: All three are right! ...Probably!

cues.text: A map that confuses intruders? A treasure!
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Impressed]: A map that confuses intruders? A treasure!

cues.text: Paper, so only 1 food in upkeep. Just tell it to stay away from Pynn.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Paper, so only 1 food in upkeep. Just tell it to stay away from Pynn.

cues.text: I am not wrong. The cave keeps folding!
cues.line: [Kkogit|Confident]: I am not wrong. The cave keeps folding!

cues.text: The folded party is currently you.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: The folded party is currently you.

cues.text: A way home for family, a sightseeing route for invaders. Can you manage?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: A way home for family, a sightseeing route for invaders. Can you manage?

cues.text: Of course! First I will guess where I am!
cues.line: [Kkogit|Happy]: Of course! First I will guess where I am!

cues.text: If Milo returns, I will send him right! Which side is my right?
cues.line: [Kkogit|Confident]: If Milo returns, I will send him right! Which side is my right?

cues.text: I will mark our route with claw signs. Please do not fold that part.
cues.line: [Rolo|Determined]: I will mark our route with claw signs. Please do not fold that part.

cues.text: Unite! Fight! More cheese tonight!
cues.line: [Jjikjjik Union|Chorus]: Unite! Fight! More cheese tonight!

cues.text: Our offer: one piece of cheese a day in exchange for vault security.
cues.line: [Goldin|Sweating]: Our offer: one piece of cheese a day in exchange for vault security.

cues.text: My castle has a union now?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Flustered]: My castle has a union now?

cues.text: We'll catch the thieves! But overtime costs extra!
cues.line: [Jjikjjik Union|Chorus]: We'll catch the thieves! But overtime costs extra!

cues.text: Which of you is the representative?
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Which of you is the representative?

cues.text: All three! Three voices! One spot of rations!
cues.line: [Jjikjjik Union|Happy]: All three! Three voices! One spot of rations!

cues.text: Three pawprints, then. Only one on the cheese receipt, please.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Three pawprints, then. Only one on the cheese receipt, please.

cues.text: Agreed! Our cave ownership claim goes in the appendix for now!
cues.line: [Jjikjjik Union|Happy]: Agreed! Our cave ownership claim goes in the appendix for now!

cues.text: Nia is not taking coins! She is taking our cheese future!
cues.line: [Jjikjjik Union|Determined]: Nia is not taking coins! She is taking our cheese future!

cues.text: I shall put that slogan on the ledger cover.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: I shall put that slogan on the ledger cover.

cues.text: That doll is STILL here?! I threw it away!
cues.line: [Nia|Horrified]: That doll is STILL here?! I threw it away!

cues.text: Thank you for that. It helped me find a new mom.
cues.line: [Nubi|Smiling]: Thank you for that. It helped me find a new mom.

cues.text: Thirty-two torn seams. All stitched.
cues.line: [Silky|Nonchalant]: Thirty-two torn seams. All stitched.

cues.text: ...Good. You're hired. Just make your eyes glow a little less when you smile.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Chilled]: ...Good. You're hired. Just make your eyes glow a little less when you smile.

cues.text: Mama, can I be the one who waits instead of the one left behind?
cues.line: [Nubi|Detached]: Mama, can I be the one who waits instead of the one left behind?

cues.text: Yes. Just do not sit in the middle of the entrance. Visitors turn back.
cues.line: [Silky|Tender]: Yes. Just do not sit in the middle of the entrance. Visitors turn back.

cues.text: If the departing visitor is a thief, that is excellent business.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: If the departing visitor is a thief, that is excellent business.

cues.text: Then I will stand half a step aside and curse them kindly.
cues.line: [Nubi|Happy]: Then I will stand half a step aside and curse them kindly.

cues.text: I will not curse Nia too painfully. She did bring me here.
cues.line: [Nubi|Detached]: I will not curse Nia too painfully. She did bring me here.

cues.text: Your heart is warm. Why is my spine cold?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Your heart is warm. Why is my spine cold?

cues.text: Contract confirmed. Mori, check the family before the ceiling.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Contract confirmed. Mori, check the family before the ceiling.

cues.text: The ceiling looks quite ill too. It keeps dripping.
cues.line: [Mori|Tender]: The ceiling looks quite ill too. It keeps dripping.

cues.text: The castle is weeping. Excess majesty does that sometimes.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: The castle is weeping. Excess majesty does that sometimes.

cues.text: May I plant mushrooms beside the majesty? They like damp places.
cues.line: [Mori|Tender]: May I plant mushrooms beside the majesty? They like damp places.

cues.text: Finance welcomes edible varieties.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Finance welcomes edible varieties.

cues.text: Eating can wait. Let the hurt ones lie down first.
cues.line: [Mori|Tender]: Eating can wait. Let the hurt ones lie down first.

cues.text: Agreed. Nobody needs to show off while receiving care.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Determined]: Agreed. Nobody needs to show off while receiving care.

cues.text: I shall deliver that rule to your lordship first.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: I shall deliver that rule to your lordship first.

cues.text: Wounds stay after Milo leaves. I will warm a place for everyone to return to.
cues.line: [Mori|Determined]: Wounds stay after Milo leaves. I will warm a place for everyone to return to.

cues.text: Pudding too? Then Pudding is definitely coming back!
cues.line: [Pudding|Happy]: Pudding too? Then Pudding is definitely coming back!

cues.text: There is a new rock in the entrance. Who authorized it?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: There is a new rock in the entrance. Who authorized it?

cues.text: Rolled here. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Solemn]: Rolled here. Kong.

cues.text: Matches the contract roster. The name is Dolkong.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Matches the contract roster. The name is Dolkong.

cues.text: Could you move a little away from the entrance?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Could you move a little away from the entrance?

cues.text: Will move even less for enemies. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Determined]: Will move even less for enemies. Kong.

cues.text: An excellent argument for spending less on doors.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: An excellent argument for spending less on doors.

cues.text: Then let us leave a path for family beside you.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Then let us leave a path for family beside you.

cues.text: That path stays open. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Solemn]: That path stays open. Kong.

cues.text: Investigator writes. I stand. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Determined]: Investigator writes. I stand. Kong.

cues.text: Just outlast the report. That appears quite possible.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Just outlast the report. That appears quite possible.

cues.text: Boom! A new recruit entrance theme! Boom-boom!
cues.line: [Dudum|Happy]: Boom! A new recruit entrance theme! Boom-boom!

cues.text: Excellent! My coronation could have used that!
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Excellent! My coronation could have used that!

cues.text: Buckets provided percussion at the coronation.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Buckets provided percussion at the coronation.

cues.text: Then the buckets can join the band! Plenty of seats!
cues.line: [Dudum|Happy]: Then the buckets can join the band! Plenty of seats!

cues.text: More musicians must not mean more fees.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: More musicians must not mean more fees.

cues.text: Playing after a meal is stronger, though. Boom?
cues.line: [Dudum|Proud]: Playing after a meal is stronger, though. Boom?

cues.text: Keep time with the family. Slower than my boasting is fine.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Keep time with the family. Slower than my boasting is fine.

cues.text: Then a song that lasts! Boom, let us go together!
cues.line: [Dudum|Determined]: Then a song that lasts! Boom, let us go together!

cues.text: Big shields will not shrink our stride! Boom!
cues.line: [Dudum|Determined]: Big shields will not shrink our stride! Boom!

cues.text: A march, please. Omit the concert bow in front of the enemy.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: A march, please. Omit the concert bow in front of the enemy.

cues.text: Checked the watchtower position. I cannot see the moon here.
cues.line: [Lumi|Whispering]: Checked the watchtower position. I cannot see the moon here.

cues.text: That is because the open-ceiling work has yet to begin.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: That is because the open-ceiling work has yet to begin.

cues.text: The present leaks are open enough.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: The present leaks are open enough.

cues.text: I did not ask you to break the roof. A small light will do.
cues.line: [Lumi|Whispering]: I did not ask you to break the roof. A small light will do.

cues.text: Would that candle help?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Would that candle help?

cues.text: Yes. Bright enough to show the way home.
cues.line: [Lumi|Whispering]: Yes. Bright enough to show the way home.

cues.text: Ceiling works cancelled. A profit on your first day.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Ceiling works cancelled. A profit on your first day.

cues.text: Count footsteps too, not just coins. As many returning as leaving.
cues.line: [Lumi|Determined]: Count footsteps too, not just coins. As many returning as leaving.

cues.text: I have read the forks on Selen's supply map. I will mark the return route too.
cues.line: [Lumi|Determined]: I have read the forks on Selen's supply map. I will mark the return route too.

cues.text: Marks serve return journeys as well as pursuit. Good judgment.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Marks serve return journeys as well as pursuit. Good judgment.

cues.text: My lord, the contracted delivery has arrived. One chest.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: My lord, the contracted delivery has arrived. One chest.

cues.text: Not… cargo… Mimi.
cues.line: [Mimi|Confident]: Not… cargo… Mimi.

cues.text: The chest protested! What an excellent demon castle!
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: The chest protested! What an excellent demon castle!

cues.text: Please do not open… I put the note there.
cues.line: [Mimi|Confident]: Please do not open… I put the note there.

cues.text: A self-issued entry restriction. We shall respect it.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: A self-issued entry restriction. We shall respect it.

cues.text: Leave the things you need… in front of me. I will pack them.
cues.line: [Mimi|Confident]: Leave the things you need… in front of me. I will pack them.

cues.text: Good. Put the bills that attack me at the very bottom.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Good. Put the bills that attack me at the very bottom.

cues.text: Deadlines keep moving at the bottom of a chest.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Deadlines keep moving at the bottom of a chest.

cues.text: If Nia comes twice… I will keep my lid shut the second time too.
cues.line: [Mimi|Determined]: If Nia comes twice… I will keep my lid shut the second time too.

cues.text: A brief quiet does not mean it is over.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: A brief quiet does not mean it is over.

cues.text: Front recruitment confirmed. Bebe, enter the office.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Front recruitment confirmed. Bebe, enter the office.

cues.text: Already in. Left the door closed.
cues.line: [Bebe|Tender]: Already in. Left the door closed.

cues.text: Through the door? Impressive. Can you teach invaders that?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Through the door? Impressive. Can you teach invaders that?

cues.text: Cancel that lesson.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Cancel that lesson.

cues.text: I will open the door for returning family. And sweep under the throne.
cues.line: [Bebe|Tender]: I will open the door for returning family. And sweep under the throne.

cues.text: Coins in dust are not rubbish. Report them immediately.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Coins in dust are not rubbish. Report them immediately.

cues.text: I will not throw out your skull as dust either.
cues.line: [Bebe|Tender]: I will not throw out your skull as dust either.

cues.text: Excellent. Cleaning and terror, handled together.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Happy]: Excellent. Cleaning and terror, handled together.

cues.text: If shields push our family back, I will find them a place to return.
cues.line: [Bebe|Determined]: If shields push our family back, I will find them a place to return.

cues.text: Please plan for family who cannot pass through walls.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Please plan for family who cannot pass through walls.

cues.text: New home smells… wet stone, embers, worry.
cues.line: [Koko|Checking]: New home smells… wet stone, embers, worry.

cues.text: That last one is not mine. It is the kingdom smelling afraid.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: That last one is not mine. It is the kingdom smelling afraid.

cues.text: Koko, as listed on the front recruitment roster.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Koko, as listed on the front recruitment roster.

cues.text: May I deduct the necklace bone from food expenses?
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: May I deduct the necklace bone from food expenses?

cues.text: That bone is not food. Must not forget its scent either.
cues.line: [Koko|Checking]: That bone is not food. Must not forget its scent either.

cues.text: Then nobody touches it. It is a family promise.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Determined]: Then nobody touches it. It is a family promise.

cues.text: I will remember your scent too. Get lost and I will come.
cues.line: [Koko|Checking]: I will remember your scent too. Get lost and I will come.

cues.text: His lordship gets lost indoors too. Thank you in advance.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: His lordship gets lost indoors too. Thank you in advance.

cues.text: Investigator scent, family scent. Different. I will scent the way home first.
cues.line: [Koko|Determined]: Investigator scent, family scent. Different. I will scent the way home first.

cues.text: Even on a hunt, remember your way home.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Even on a hunt, remember your way home.

cues.text: Tok. From the front. What needs fixing?
cues.line: [Toktok|Checking]: Tok. From the front. What needs fixing?

cues.text: Start asking at the entrance.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Start asking at the entrance.

cues.text: Stop the estimate at the entrance, please.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Stop the estimate at the entrance, please.

cues.text: Scratches stay even when money is scared. Tok.
cues.line: [Toktok|Checking]: Scratches stay even when money is scared. Tok.

cues.text: Correct. No rebuttal.

cues.text: I may not be able to speak, but I can still reach out first.

cues.text: A glove can slip. Family will not.

cues.text: Even after the retreat order, Pudding blocked the gate until the last ally passed through.

cues.text: As long as Pudding holds, no one gets left alone.

cues.text: I will not let guarding the gate keep you from getting out too.

cues.text: When the last one leaves, Pudding leaves too!

cues.text: At the victory feast, Pudding took the cherry off its head and placed it on the Demon Lord's plate.

cues.text: Share it, and even loot tastes like family.

cues.text: A cherry on my plate too. Redder than a crown.

cues.text: A bite each means it is not Pudding's party alone!

cues.text: Instead of pocketing a coin from the expedition, Gob dropped it into the repair fund.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Instead of pocketing a coin from the expedition, Gob dropped it into the repair fund.

cues.text: I didn't steal it. I invested when nobody was looking.
cues.line: [Gob|Grinning]: I didn't steal it. I invested when nobody was looking.

cues.text: I saw. That repair box got your happy laugh along with the coin.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: I saw. That repair box got your happy laugh along with the coin.

cues.text: Pretend you did not! Gob being cool is secret!
cues.line: [Gob|Happy]: Pretend you did not! Gob being cool is secret!

cues.text: Gob entrusted the Demon Lord with a copy of his most prized vault key.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Gob entrusted the Demon Lord with a copy of his most prized vault key.

cues.text: Lose it, and you pay. With your life, not Gold.
cues.line: [Gob|Grinning]: Lose it, and you pay. With your life, not Gold.

cues.text: I will keep the copy. We open it together when you return.

cues.text: Not returning is Gob's loss! Coming back!

cues.text: Gob shared the treasure map he found first with the family, without putting a price on it.

cues.text: Rob it together, and we can crack bigger vaults.

cues.text: You shared the map. Why no price?

cues.text: Family discount today! All of it!
cues.line: [Gob|Happy]: Family discount today! All of it!

cues.text: Pynn tended the brazier all night to keep the wounded monsters' recovery room warm.

cues.text: Fire does more than burn things, you know.
cues.line: [Pynn|Confident]: Fire does more than burn things, you know.

cues.text: You kept the hearth all night. Rest this morning.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: You kept the hearth all night. Rest this morning.

cues.text: Passing the ember over. You relight it if it goes out.
cues.line: [Pynn|Happy]: Passing the ember over. You relight it if it goes out.

cues.text: Your next spell matters before the wall bill. Let us read it together.

cues.text: As long as we remember, they haven't gone out completely.
cues.line: [Pynn|Confident]: As long as we remember, they haven't gone out completely.

cues.text: Let us read those ash-written names again. No hurry.

cues.text: An ember knows how to burn slowly too.
cues.line: [Pynn|Happy]: An ember knows how to burn slowly too.

cues.text: Rolo marked a shortcut through the rocks on the Demon Castle map for the first time. Until then, only Rolo had known it.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Rolo marked a shortcut through the rocks on the Demon Castle map for the first time. Until then, only Rolo had known it.

cues.text: It's our path now, not just my escape route.
cues.line: [Rolo|Checking]: It's our path now, not just my escape route.

cues.text: Sharing a secret path does not erase the secret.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Aggrieved]: Sharing a secret path does not erase the secret.

cues.text: Right. More people to protect it now.
cues.line: [Rolo|Happy]: Right. More people to protect it now.

cues.text: Rolo reported exactly why the expedition had been endangered, without hiding the mistake.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Rolo reported exactly why the expedition had been endangered, without hiding the mistake.

cues.text: This time, the truth matters more than rumors.
cues.line: [Rolo|Checking]: This time, the truth matters more than rumors.

cues.text: Your returning voice is better than a false report. Keep telling the truth.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Your returning voice is better than a false report. Keep telling the truth.

cues.text: Next report will have space for my mistakes too.
cues.line: [Rolo|Happy]: Next report will have space for my mistakes too.

cues.text: After scouting, Rolo left small claw marks the family would recognize along every fastest route home.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: After scouting, Rolo left small claw marks the family would recognize along every fastest route home.

cues.text: If you get lost, follow my marks. They'll bring you home.
cues.line: [Rolo|Checking]: If you get lost, follow my marks. They'll bring you home.

cues.text: The claw marks end here. Home at last.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: The claw marks end here. Home at last.

cues.text: Yes. Let us make the last mark together.
cues.line: [Rolo|Happy]: Yes. Let us make the last mark together.

cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: At the bottom of demand number 37, Pongdang added a tiny note: "Will guard the bridge."

cues.text: Whoever owns the place, the water needs protecting, you know.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Deadpan]: Whoever owns the place, the water needs protecting, you know.

cues.text: Read number thirty-seven too. Including the tiny promise to guard the bridge.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Read number thirty-seven too. Including the tiny promise to guard the bridge.

cues.text: Small print still counts, you know.

scenes.title: A Song for a Leaky Night

cues.text: Even drips make a lullaby if the beat is right, you know.

cues.text: The buckets might fall asleep first tonight.

cues.text: The empty bucket handles the low notes, you know.

cues.text: I'm dropping the demand. It's our pond now.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Deadpan]: I'm dropping the demand. It's our pond now.

cues.text: A sign instead of a demand. Room for my name?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: A sign instead of a demand. Room for my name?

cues.text: You are already in the word ours, you know.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Happy]: You are already in the word ours, you know.

cues.text: Neurit took a whole day to reach the throne and say hello. The Demon Lord stayed put the entire time.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Neurit took a whole day to reach the throne and say hello. The Demon Lord stayed put the entire time.

cues.text: You're... the first... to wait... for me.
cues.line: [Neurit|Whispering]: You're... the first... to wait... for me.

cues.text: Waiting a day by the throne was worth it. Heard your whole greeting.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Waiting a day by the throne was worth it. Heard your whole greeting.

cues.text: After hello… I can say… the next part slowly… too…
cues.line: [Neurit|Happy]: After hello… I can say… the next part slowly… too…

cues.text: Neurit watched for a long time as the family tiptoed around the slime trail instead of stepping on it.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Neurit watched for a long time as the family tiptoed around the slime trail instead of stepping on it.

cues.text: A home... that protects... my little trails.
cues.line: [Neurit|Whispering]: A home... that protects... my little trails.

cues.text: We may look silly on tiptoe. Your trail stays.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: We may look silly on tiptoe. Your trail stays.

cues.text: I will remember… those footsteps… too…
cues.line: [Neurit|Happy]: I will remember… those footsteps… too…

cues.text: For the first time ever, Neurit unpacked the shell and placed each belonging on a barracks shelf.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: For the first time ever, Neurit unpacked the shell and placed each belonging on a barracks shelf.

cues.text: Here... it's okay... to take... my time?
cues.line: [Neurit|Whispering]: Here... it's okay... to take... my time?

cues.text: One shelf is yours. I will keep it clear until you finish unpacking.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: One shelf is yours. I will keep it clear until you finish unpacking.

cues.text: Today… the little window ornament… goes first…
cues.line: [Neurit|Happy]: Today… the little window ornament… goes first…

cues.text: The back of Beongbeong's resume listed every bridge ever guarded. The last line was blank.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: The back of Beongbeong's resume listed every bridge ever guarded. The last line was blank.

cues.text: That blank... is for this bridge's name.
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Tearful]: That blank... is for this bridge's name.

cues.text: The last blank is our bridge. Shall we choose its name together?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: The last blank is our bridge. Shall we choose its name together?

cues.text: Yes! My resume is not finished yet!
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Happy]: Yes! My resume is not finished yet!

cues.text: When wood became stone, Beongbeong arrived wearing a tie, certain it was a promotion.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: When wood became stone, Beongbeong arrived wearing a tie, certain it was a promotion.

cues.text: If the bridge gets tougher, so must I!
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Tearful]: If the bridge gets tougher, so must I!

cues.text: If the bridge got promoted, congratulations. Do not tighten that tie too much.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: If the bridge got promoted, congratulations. Do not tighten that tie too much.

cues.text: Now I have work even where things are sturdy!
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Happy]: Now I have work even where things are sturdy!

cues.text: Beongbeong carved a sign beside the bridge: "If this bridge falls, I'll be the bridge."
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Beongbeong carved a sign beside the bridge: "If this bridge falls, I'll be the bridge."

cues.text: I wasn't looking for a sturdy bridge. I wanted one worth protecting.
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Tearful]: I wasn't looking for a sturdy bridge. I wanted one worth protecting.

cues.text: Thank you for the sign. We will brace it before you become the bridge.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Thank you for the sign. We will brace it before you become the bridge.

cues.text: Then I will put my coworkers' names on my resume too!
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Happy]: Then I will put my coworkers' names on my resume too!

cues.text: Shh tried and failed to greet the Demon Lord face-to-face, then used a shadow hand to dust off the cloak instead.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Shh tried and failed to greet the Demon Lord face-to-face, then used a shadow hand to dust off the cloak instead.

cues.text: Face-to-face... is still too embarrassing.
cues.line: [Shh|Whispering]: Face-to-face... is still too embarrassing.

cues.text: Cloak dust gone. I understood that better than a face-to-face hello.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Flustered]: Cloak dust gone. I understood that better than a face-to-face hello.

cues.text: Next time… I will hold my hand out a little longer…
cues.line: [Shh|Happy]: Next time… I will hold my hand out a little longer…

cues.text: When the youngest in the barracks had a nightmare, Shh crawled under the bed and whispered "It's okay" all night.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: When the youngest in the barracks had a nightmare, Shh crawled under the bed and whispered "It's okay" all night.

cues.text: Being beside someone... feels better than scaring them.
cues.line: [Shh|Whispering]: Being beside someone... feels better than scaring them.

cues.text: You said it was all right all night. Tonight someone stays beside you too.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: You said it was all right all night. Tonight someone stays beside you too.

cues.text: Then… I do not have to be scary… right…
cues.line: [Shh|Happy]: Then… I do not have to be scary… right…

scenes.title: The Day You Called My Name

cues.text: When the Demon Lord called into the dark, "Shh, are you there?", Shh stepped out of the shadows for the first time.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: When the Demon Lord called into the dark, "Shh, are you there?", Shh stepped out of the shadows for the first time.

cues.text: When someone looks for you, even a shadow has a home.
cues.line: [Shh|Shy]: When someone looks for you, even a shadow has a home.

cues.text: Shh, there you are in front of me. Found you without turning.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Shh, there you are in front of me. Found you without turning.

cues.text: Next time you call… I will answer from here too…
cues.line: [Shh|Happy]: Next time you call… I will answer from here too…

scenes.title: A Name in an Empty Helm

cues.text: Beside the old master's name inside the helm, Teongteong secretly scratched a small "Teongteong."

cues.text: Even if I'm empty, I should have a name.
cues.line: [Teongteong|Righteous]: Even if I'm empty, I should have a name.

cues.text: Added your name without erasing the old one. Well done.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Added your name without erasing the old one. Well done.

cues.text: Now when the helmet rings, I know whose voice it is.
cues.line: [Teongteong|Happy]: Now when the helmet rings, I know whose voice it is.

cues.text: When Pudding polished the rust with jelly hands, Teongteong felt warmth inside the armor for the first time.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: When Pudding polished the rust with jelly hands, Teongteong felt warmth inside the armor for the first time.

cues.text: I thought heroes stood alone. A hero can have a family, too.
cues.line: [Teongteong|Righteous]: I thought heroes stood alone. A hero can have a family, too.

cues.text: A hero with someone to polish rust is still a hero. No need to be alone.

cues.text: Never been warm armor before. Makes me creak a little.
cues.line: [Teongteong|Happy]: Never been warm armor before. Makes me creak a little.

cues.text: The night before Leon arrived, Teongteong knelt before the throne and swore an oath to today's family, not the old master.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: The night before Leon arrived, Teongteong knelt before the throne and swore an oath to today's family, not the old master.

cues.text: I don't know about justice. But this post is mine to guard.

cues.text: I still remember your oath the night before Leon came.

cues.text: Since that night, I have held this post under my own name.
cues.line: [Teongteong|Happy]: Since that night, I have held this post under my own name.

cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Noknok finally revealed that its wick came from the first Demon Lord's birthday cake.

cues.text: I was lit for a celebration. I can't just go out!
cues.line: [Noknok|Fear]: I was lit for a celebration. I can't just go out!

cues.text: A cake wick lit this castle. Count on you for the next celebration.

cues.text: Then I will practice birthday songs instead of screams!
cues.line: [Noknok|Happy]: Then I will practice birthday songs instead of screams!

cues.text: When the ceiling leaked, Noknok screamed but moved the buckets above the family's beds first.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: When the ceiling leaked, Noknok screamed but moved the buckets above the family's beds first.

cues.text: Being scared is one thing. Getting the job done is another!
cues.line: [Noknok|Fear]: Being scared is one thing. Getting the job done is another!

cues.text: You moved the buckets over beds before your own. Scared, still brave.

cues.text: After those buckets, mine too, please! Just changed the order!

cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: After the Demon Lord put a little roof above the throne, Noknok burned through the night without trembling for the first time.

cues.text: I can stay lit here. There's a roof looking out for me.
cues.line: [Noknok|Screaming]: I can stay lit here. There's a roof looking out for me.

cues.text: A small roof, but it kept you safe all night. I wanted to protect your light too.

cues.text: The drips did not scare me tonight. Only a little!

cues.text: The rats dropped their claim to being the cave's true owners and carved their little names beneath the castle nameplate.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: The rats dropped their claim to being the cave's true owners and carved their little names beneath the castle nameplate.

cues.text: Let's be family, not owners. That lasts longer!
cues.line: [Jjikjjik Union|Chorus]: Let's be family, not owners. That lasts longer!

cues.text: Names together below the sign. Ownership dispute settled?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Names together below the sign. Ownership dispute settled?

cues.text: Fold the claim, unfold the table!
cues.line: [Jjikjjik Union|Happy]: Fold the claim, unfold the table!

cues.text: When Silky tied the final knot, Nubi said "Thank you" for the first time instead of "I'll curse you."
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: When Silky tied the final knot, Nubi said "Thank you" for the first time instead of "I'll curse you."

cues.text: The hands that stitched me... will never get my curse.
cues.line: [Nubi|Detached]: The hands that stitched me... will never get my curse.

cues.text: You remember all thirty-two knots.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: You remember all thirty-two knots.

cues.text: Places Mama touched are not scary.
cues.line: [Nubi|Happy]: Places Mama touched are not scary.

cues.text: Nubi sent Nia a letter saying "Thank you for throwing me away." Nia left a bag of sweets by the door without a reply.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Nubi sent Nia a letter saying "Thank you for throwing me away." Nia left a bag of sweets by the door without a reply.

cues.text: It's okay to be scared. Come visit next time.
cues.line: [Nubi|Detached]: It's okay to be scared. Come visit next time.

cues.text: No reply, but candy arrived. More honest than an envelope, perhaps.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: No reply, but candy arrived. More honest than an envelope, perhaps.

cues.text: Next time we could eat it together by the door.
cues.line: [Nubi|Happy]: Next time we could eat it together by the door.

scenes.title: The Place That Hurts for You

cues.text: After a great battle left Nubi with new tears, the family took turns adding a stitch each.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: After a great battle left Nubi with new tears, the family took turns adding a stitch each.

cues.text: Most of my stitches belong to my family now.
cues.line: [Nubi|Detached]: Most of my stitches belong to my family now.

cues.text: More of our stitches now. You will not bear pain alone.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: More of our stitches now. You will not bear pain alone.

cues.text: Even the crooked ones look like the family's handwriting.
cues.line: [Nubi|Happy]: Even the crooked ones look like the family's handwriting.

cues.text: After the first battle, Mori spread spores over wounded Pudding like a blanket and stayed by the bed all night.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: After the first battle, Mori spread spores over wounded Pudding like a blanket and stayed by the bed all night.

cues.text: Wounds closing slowly hurt the least.
cues.line: [Mori|Tender]: Wounds closing slowly hurt the least.

cues.text: You watched Pudding's blanket all night. I will mind your rest.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: You watched Pudding's blanket all night. I will mind your rest.

cues.text: Spores spread better after a little rest too.
cues.line: [Mori|Happy]: Spores spread better after a little rest too.

cues.text: When Goldin worried about mold by the throne, Mori turned it into a mushroom garden and named it "A Garden of Authority."
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: When Goldin worried about mold by the throne, Mori turned it into a mushroom garden and named it "A Garden of Authority."

cues.text: Even a damp place can grow something pretty.
cues.line: [Mori|Tender]: Even a damp place can grow something pretty.

cues.text: A garden of majesty instead of mold. Grand name, gentle smell.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: A garden of majesty instead of mold. Grand name, gentle smell.

cues.text: Majesty lasts longer when it can breathe.
cues.line: [Mori|Happy]: Majesty lasts longer when it can breathe.

cues.text: Mori tucked the castle's first white mushroom flower into the buttonhole of the Demon Lord's cloak.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Mori tucked the castle's first white mushroom flower into the buttonhole of the Demon Lord's cloak.

cues.text: When this castle grows healthy, I bloom too.
cues.line: [Mori|Tender]: When this castle grows healthy, I bloom too.

cues.text: A flower in my cloak buttonhole. Today I will show this before my boasting.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Flustered]: A flower in my cloak buttonhole. Today I will show this before my boasting.

cues.text: Give it a little sunlight when you show it off.
cues.line: [Mori|Happy]: Give it a little sunlight when you show it off.

cues.text: Dolkong rolled down in a landslide and lodged in the entrance. When nobody could move the stone, it became the gatekeeper.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Dolkong rolled down in a landslide and lodged in the entrance. When nobody could move the stone, it became the gatekeeper.

cues.text: A rolling stone settles down. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Solemn]: A rolling stone settles down. Kong.

cues.text: The stone nobody could move became our guard. Now it is a post you choose.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: The stone nobody could move became our guard. Now it is a post you choose.

cues.text: Planted, found somewhere to return. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Happy]: Planted, found somewhere to return. Kong.

cues.text: When moss watered by Pongdang wrapped around Dolkong's neck, the stone said it no longer felt cold.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: When moss watered by Pongdang wrapped around Dolkong's neck, the stone said it no longer felt cold.

cues.text: Even stone can feel warm. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Solemn]: Even stone can feel warm. Kong.

cues.text: Pongdang's water made a moss scarf. That color suits you.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Pongdang's water made a moss scarf. That color suits you.

cues.text: Family color, more than stone color. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Happy]: Family color, more than stone color. Kong.

cues.text: Asked why the stone never left its post, Dolkong said moving would block the family's way through.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Asked why the stone never left its post, Dolkong said moving would block the family's way through.

cues.text: Where I stand is the door everyone comes home through. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Solemn]: Where I stand is the door everyone comes home through. Kong.

cues.text: I will remember. Your standing there keeps the way open.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: I will remember. Your standing there keeps the way open.

cues.text: Side space stays clear when you return. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Happy]: Side space stays clear when you return. Kong.

cues.text: Dudum's drum was broken and discarded at a kingdom festival. Pynn dried the hide with fire and brought its voice back.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Dudum's drum was broken and discarded at a kingdom festival. Pynn dried the hide with fire and brought its voice back.

cues.text: Boom! If it sounds again, we start again!
cues.line: [Dudum|Proud]: Boom! If it sounds again, we start again!

cues.text: An abandoned drum sounded again. Pynn must have heard it too.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: An abandoned drum sounded again. Pynn must have heard it too.

cues.text: Next song gets an ember beat too! Boom!
cues.line: [Dudum|Happy]: Next song gets an ember beat too! Boom!

cues.text: On a leaky night, Dudum drummed along with the ceiling drips, woke everyone up, and got quite a scolding.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: On a leaky night, Dudum drummed along with the ceiling drips, woke everyone up, and got quite a scolding.

cues.text: The beat was too good. I couldn't help it. Boom...
cues.line: [Dudum|Proud]: The beat was too good. I couldn't help it. Boom...

cues.text: The drips have good rhythm. Next time, check sleeping family's rhythm first.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: The drips have good rhythm. Next time, check sleeping family's rhythm first.

cues.text: Boom by day, rests by night! Remembered!
cues.line: [Dudum|Happy]: Boom by day, rests by night! Remembered!

cues.text: Dudum wrote a march with every family member's name, leaving the final verse blank.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Dudum wrote a march with every family member's name, leaving the final verse blank.

cues.text: That's for the next new family member. Boom-boom!
cues.line: [Dudum|Proud]: That's for the next new family member. Boom-boom!

cues.text: Last verse blank. For family we have yet to meet?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Last verse blank. For family we have yet to meet?

cues.text: Long names? Add more beats! Boom-boom!
cues.line: [Dudum|Happy]: Long names? Add more beats! Boom-boom!

cues.text: Moonlight tracker Lumi hated a cave without a moon, but learned to call Noknok's flame "a little moon."
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Moonlight tracker Lumi hated a cave without a moon, but learned to call Noknok's flame "a little moon."

cues.text: No moon? Make one. Even a tiny one.
cues.line: [Lumi|Whispering]: No moon? Make one. Even a tiny one.

cues.text: Calling Noknok a little moon made the trembling ease.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Calling Noknok a little moon made the trembling ease.

cues.text: With light, the direction home matters more than size.
cues.line: [Lumi|Happy]: With light, the direction home matters more than size.

cues.text: The first day Lumi lost a target, the tracker carried wounded Gob home instead of giving chase.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: The first day Lumi lost a target, the tracker carried wounded Gob home instead of giving chase.

cues.text: There'll be more targets. You only get one chance with family.
cues.line: [Lumi|Whispering]: There'll be more targets. You only get one chance with family.

cues.text: Target lost, Gob brought home. That is the report's first line.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Target lost, Gob brought home. That is the report's first line.

cues.text: Next mark, I check the family return line first too.
cues.line: [Lumi|Happy]: Next mark, I check the family return line first too.

cues.text: Lumi left invisible moonlight marks on the family's foreheads, so they could be found even if lost.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Lumi left invisible moonlight marks on the family's foreheads, so they could be found even if lost.

cues.text: My marks were always meant to help me find you.
cues.line: [Lumi|Whispering]: My marks were always meant to help me find you.

cues.text: Cannot see it, but my forehead feels warm. A sign you will find me?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Cannot see it, but my forehead feels warm. A sign you will find me?

cues.text: Yes. For coming back, not hiding away.
cues.line: [Lumi|Happy]: Yes. For coming back, not hiding away.

cues.text: The "Please Do Not Open" note on Mimi's lid was actually put there by a very shy Mimi.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: The "Please Do Not Open" note on Mimi's lid was actually put there by a very shy Mimi.

cues.text: If you open it... I'll be the first one startled.
cues.line: [Mimi|Confident]: If you open it... I'll be the first one startled.

cues.text: You put up that do-not-open note. I will wait for permission.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: You put up that do-not-open note. I will wait for permission.

cues.text: Then… opening a little might be less frightening.
cues.line: [Mimi|Happy]: Then… opening a little might be less frightening.

cues.text: Mimi used to carry only fake treasure, until one day a pebble from the family became the first real treasure inside.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Mimi used to carry only fake treasure, until one day a pebble from the family became the first real treasure inside.

cues.text: I'm not spitting this one out for anyone.
cues.line: [Mimi|Confident]: I'm not spitting this one out for anyone.

cues.text: One pebble sits deeper than the coins.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: One pebble sits deeper than the coins.

cues.text: From family… did not put a price on it.
cues.line: [Mimi|Happy]: From family… did not put a price on it.

cues.text: Mimi promised that if the castle ever moved, every family member's luggage would be carried inside.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Mimi promised that if the castle ever moved, every family member's luggage would be carried inside.

cues.text: When the castle grows, so will I. Big enough to hold it all.
cues.line: [Mimi|Confident]: When the castle grows, so will I. Big enough to hold it all.

cues.text: We will carry things together when we move. Do not hide among the luggage.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: We will carry things together when we move. Do not hide among the luggage.

cues.text: Then first… save a place for me.
cues.line: [Mimi|Happy]: Then first… save a place for me.

scenes.title: The Maid Who Needs No Key

cues.text: Bebe slipped silently through locked doors, but left the door wide open for the family coming home.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Bebe slipped silently through locked doors, but left the door wide open for the family coming home.

cues.text: I don't need a key. But family coming home needs an open door.
cues.line: [Bebe|Tender]: I don't need a key. But family coming home needs an open door.

cues.text: Saw you open it for us, even though you pass through.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Saw you open it for us, even though you pass through.

cues.text: Returning footsteps sound clearer with a door.
cues.line: [Bebe|Happy]: Returning footsteps sound clearer with a door.

cues.text: Sweeping beneath the Throne, Bebe found an old button left by the first Demon Lord and handed it to the current one.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Sweeping beneath the Throne, Bebe found an old button left by the first Demon Lord and handed it to the current one.

cues.text: Clear away the dust, but don't throw away the feelings beneath it.
cues.line: [Bebe|Tender]: Clear away the dust, but don't throw away the feelings beneath it.

cues.text: You saved the first lord's button from the rubbish. I will keep it carefully.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: You saved the first lord's button from the rubbish. I will keep it carefully.

cues.text: Throw out everything old and the castle grows too light.
cues.line: [Bebe|Happy]: Throw out everything old and the castle grows too light.

cues.text: While everyone slept, Bebe and the Demon Lord walked the ruined halls together, leaving lamps in empty rooms to light tomorrow.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: While everyone slept, Bebe and the Demon Lord walked the ruined halls together, leaving lamps in empty rooms to light tomorrow.

cues.text: Walk that last round with me. Then this castle will really feel like our home.
cues.line: [Bebe|Tender]: Walk that last round with me. Then this castle will really feel like our home.

cues.text: Lights in empty rooms show a little of tomorrow. Walk the next round with me too.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Lights in empty rooms show a little of tomorrow. Walk the next round with me too.

cues.text: Yes. Check the last door together.
cues.line: [Bebe|Happy]: Yes. Check the last door together.

cues.text: Even at mealtimes, Koko never chewed the old bone on the collar. It was a token from the gravekeeper who first called Koko family.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Even at mealtimes, Koko never chewed the old bone on the collar. It was a token from the gravekeeper who first called Koko family.

cues.text: This bone isn't food. It's the promise that kept me from getting lost.
cues.line: [Koko|Checking]: This bone isn't food. It's the promise that kept me from getting lost.

cues.text: A promise from the gravekeeper. Now I know why hunger never touches it.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: A promise from the gravekeeper. Now I know why hunger never touches it.

cues.text: New family scents stay beside it in memory.
cues.line: [Koko|Happy]: New family scents stay beside it in memory.

cues.text: After following an enemy decoy's scent, Koko returned alone, touched a nose to the Demon Lord's hand, and chose the path again.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: After following an enemy decoy's scent, Koko returned alone, touched a nose to the Demon Lord's hand, and chose the path again.

cues.text: It's okay to get it wrong once. If I remember your scent, I can find my way again.
cues.line: [Koko|Checking]: It's okay to get it wrong once. If I remember your scent, I can find my way again.

cues.text: You returned from the wrong scent yourself. My hand is here.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: You returned from the wrong scent yourself. My hand is here.

cues.text: This time, checked home scent first.
cues.line: [Koko|Happy]: This time, checked home scent first.

cues.text: Koko left blue embers at every fork outside the castle. The last ember always shone before the Throne.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Koko left blue embers at every fork outside the castle. The last ember always shone before the Throne.

cues.text: Home isn't one place. Every path back to you is home.
cues.line: [Koko|Checking]: Home isn't one place. Every path back to you is home.

cues.text: Last blue ember before the throne. The whole route became home.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Last blue ember before the throne. The whole route became home.

cues.text: The way I came is not a lonely path now.
cues.line: [Koko|Happy]: The way I came is not a lonely path now.

cues.text: Toktok took the finest plate intended for the shell and patched the Demon Lord's old armor first.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Toktok took the finest plate intended for the shell and patched the Demon Lord's old armor first.

cues.text: My back is still strong. You use this plate first.
cues.line: [Toktok|Checking]: My back is still strong. You use this plate first.

cues.text: Best plate on my armor first. Next one is for your back.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Best plate on my armor first. Next one is for your back.

cues.text: Not repaying. Bracing together. Tok.
cues.line: [Toktok|Happy]: Not repaying. Bracing together. Tok.

cues.text: The Demon Lord sat Toktok down after endless repairs and polished every purple rivet. Toktok's shell hummed a low rhythm all day.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: The Demon Lord sat Toktok down after endless repairs and polished every purple rivet. Toktok's shell hummed a low rhythm all day.

cues.text: So we need days to shine, not just days to mend.
cues.line: [Toktok|Checking]: So we need days to shine, not just days to mend.

cues.text: Polishing the rivets, I never knew purple could shine so bright.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Polishing the rivets, I never knew purple could shine so bright.

cues.text: Hands can visit even without a fault. Tok-tok.
cues.line: [Toktok|Happy]: Hands can visit even without a fault. Tok-tok.

cues.text: The night the Heart Chamber cracked, Toktok fixed the last plate to the castle's heart and braced it with the shell until it set.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: The night the Heart Chamber cracked, Toktok fixed the last plate to the castle's heart and braced it with the shell until it set.

cues.text: As long as the castle beats, I'll hold. We're inside the same shell.
cues.line: [Toktok|Checking]: As long as the castle beats, I'll hold. We're inside the same shell.

cues.text: While the heart plate set, your back was the wall. Our turn to brace.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: While the heart plate set, your back was the wall. Our turn to brace.

cues.text: Under one shell, take turns bracing. Tok.
cues.line: [Toktok|Happy]: Under one shell, take turns bracing. Tok.

cues.text: Silky silently shortened the Demon Lord's cape by a handspan, worried it would get stepped on in battle. The Demon Lord spent a long time deciding whether to object on grounds of dignity or safety.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Silky silently shortened the Demon Lord's cape by a handspan, worried it would get stepped on in battle. The Demon Lord spent a long time deciding whether to object on grounds of dignity or safety.

cues.text: My cloak lost a handspan. Did my majesty get cut too?
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: My cloak lost a handspan. Did my majesty get cut too?

cues.text: If your feet do not catch, your majesty will not fall.
cues.line: [Silky|Tender]: If your feet do not catch, your majesty will not fall.

cues.text: Then from today, call it safe majesty.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Then from today, call it safe majesty.

cues.text: Silver curtains appeared along the outpost's retreat route. They were so pretty that soldiers kept turning back for one last look before fleeing.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Silver curtains appeared along the outpost's retreat route. They were so pretty that soldiers kept turning back for one last look before fleeing.

cues.text: The curtain is a way out, not something to turn back and admire.
cues.line: [Silky|Tender]: The curtain is a way out, not something to turn back and admire.

cues.text: Let the family survive to admire it another day.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Let the family survive to admire it another day.

cues.text: Yes. Pretty things stay pretty for later.
cues.line: [Silky|Smiling]: Yes. Pretty things stay pretty for later.

cues.text: Silky measured the candidates’ heads for a crown cover in the new Crown Chamber. Popo insisted counting ears was cheating.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Silky measured the candidates’ heads for a crown cover in the new Crown Chamber. Popo insisted counting ears was cheating.

cues.text: Head measurements for the cover. Separate room so ears are not squashed.
cues.line: [Silky|Tender]: Head measurements for the cover. Separate room so ears are not squashed.

cues.text: We built a crown room and still argue about measurements.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: We built a crown room and still argue about measurements.

cues.text: A crown needs to fit its wearer or it rolls away.
cues.line: [Silky|Smiling]: A crown needs to fit its wearer or it rolls away.

cues.text: Popo folded the council invitation three times into a tiny paper bat. The recipient found out late, but the paper bat reached the correct seat first.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Popo folded the council invitation three times into a tiny paper bat. The recipient found out late, but the paper bat reached the correct seat first.

cues.text: Paper bat seated first! Recipient reads later!
cues.line: [Popo|Happy]: Paper bat seated first! Recipient reads later!

cues.text: The council invitation is quicker at manners than I am.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: The council invitation is quicker at manners than I am.

cues.text: Next time I will include unfolding instructions!
cues.line: [Popo|Happy]: Next time I will include unfolding instructions!

cues.text: Popo barely recovered Goldin's bundle of receipts from a rival Demon Lord's mailbox. The excuse that the amounts looked scarier than the address was rejected.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Popo barely recovered Goldin's bundle of receipts from a rival Demon Lord's mailbox. The excuse that the amounts looked scarier than the address was rejected.

cues.text: Recovering it at a rival lord's mailbox must have shaken your wings.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Recovering it at a rival lord's mailbox must have shaken your wings.

cues.text: Read the amount and my wings turned around on their own!
cues.line: [Popo|Proud]: Read the amount and my wings turned around on their own!

cues.text: Read the address first next time. Shorter than the amount.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Read the address first next time. Shorter than the amount.

scenes.title: A Title Longer Than a Name

cues.text: Popo grumbled that writing out 'Grand Crown Herald' left no room for the address on an envelope. Silky agreed to embroider an abbreviation.
cues.line: [Narrator|Calm]: Popo grumbled that writing out 'Grand Crown Herald' left no room for the address on an envelope. Silky agreed to embroider an abbreviation.

cues.text: Write Crown Grand Courier in full and the recipient's name flies off!
cues.line: [Popo|Proud]: Write Crown Grand Courier in full and the recipient's name flies off!

cues.text: With Silky's abbreviation embroidery, put the recipient before the title.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: With Silky's abbreviation embroidery, put the recipient before the title.

cues.text: Right! Family names get priority delivery over my title!
cues.line: [Popo|Happy]: Right! Family names get priority delivery over my title!

cues.text: To spread the spore blanket, I need a steady place.
cues.line: [Mori|Determined]: To spread the spore blanket, I need a steady place.

cues.text: On Pudding's head! Pudding can stay still a bit!
cues.line: [Pudding|Happy]: On Pudding's head! Pudding can stay still a bit!

cues.text: The others cover you while you both pause.
cues.line: [Bati|Cool]: The others cover you while you both pause.

cues.text: Hitting later! Time to cover everyone now!
cues.line: [Pudding|Happy]: Hitting later! Time to cover everyone now!

cues.text: Yes. While they are sheltered, tend the wounds quietly.
cues.line: [Mori|Smiling]: Yes. While they are sheltered, tend the wounds quietly.

cues.text: Good. Sounds like an attack name, but it is a place to rest.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Good. Sounds like an attack name, but it is a place to rest.

cues.text: I will find the gap for the hurt ones to leave.
cues.line: [Bebe|Firm]: I will find the gap for the hurt ones to leave.

cues.text: Pudding covers from the side! A little heavier is fine!
cues.line: [Pudding|Determined]: Pudding covers from the side! A little heavier is fine!

cues.text: The redirected share endangers Pudding too. This is no endless wall.
cues.line: [Bati|Cool]: The redirected share endangers Pudding too. This is no endless wall.

cues.text: That is why I check the clear space first.
cues.line: [Bebe|Smiling]: That is why I check the clear space first.

cues.text: Wait if Pudding slows down! The moving crew comes back too!
cues.line: [Pudding|Happy]: Wait if Pudding slows down! The moving crew comes back too!

cues.text: Count family before luggage. Our castle's moving rule.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Tender]: Count family before luggage. Our castle's moving rule.

cues.text: Koko, saw the target scent? No, smelled it?
cues.line: [Gob|Confident]: Koko, saw the target scent? No, smelled it?

cues.text: Smelled. The way back too.
cues.line: [Koko|Determined]: Smelled. The way back too.

cues.text: Then Gob forward! Fist forward too!
cues.line: [Gob|Confident]: Then Gob forward! Fist forward too!

cues.text: Both of you are more exposed after the pursuit. Check the retreat.
cues.line: [Bati|Cool]: Both of you are more exposed after the pursuit. Check the retreat.

cues.text: If Gob scent gets far, I bring him back.
cues.line: [Koko|Happy]: If Gob scent gets far, I bring him back.

cues.text: Grab Gob's ear if too far! Not coins!
cues.line: [Gob|Pleased]: Grab Gob's ear if too far! Not coins!

cues.text: Cleared a place to heat the plate. Tok.
cues.line: [Toktok|Firm]: Cleared a place to heat the plate. Tok.

cues.text: I handle the fire. Your back stays uncooked.
cues.line: [Pynn|Determined]: I handle the fire. Your back stays uncooked.

cues.text: Repairs will be slower. Telling you first.
cues.line: [Toktok|Firm]: Repairs will be slower. Telling you first.

cues.text: This combination includes the repair wait after the attack.
cues.line: [Bati|Cool]: This combination includes the repair wait after the attack.

cues.text: Understood. One back returning matters more than one spectacular flame.
cues.line: [Pynn|Smiling]: Understood. One back returning matters more than one spectacular flame.

cues.text: With that, moving out. Tok-tok.
cues.line: [Toktok|Pleased]: With that, moving out. Tok-tok.

cues.text: Dolkong, one step per beat!
cues.line: [Dudum|Determined]: Dolkong, one step per beat!

cues.text: Add a stopping beat. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Firm]: Add a stopping beat. Kong.

cues.text: Stopping is part of a march! Boom, rest!
cues.line: [Dudum|Determined]: Stopping is part of a march! Boom, rest!

cues.text: Guard the side route while Dolkong cannot move after activation.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Guard the side route while Dolkong cannot move after activation.

cues.text: When I stand, beside me is the road. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Moved]: When I stand, beside me is the road. Kong.

cues.text: Good! We will match even your resting beat!
cues.line: [Dudum|Happy]: Good! We will match even your resting beat!

cues.text: The fake treasure inside me… can you make it shine?
cues.line: [Mimi|Flustered]: The fake treasure inside me… can you make it shine?

cues.text: Yes. A mark on it, a clear way back.
cues.line: [Lumi|Firm]: Yes. A mark on it, a clear way back.

cues.text: Do not expect it to fool thieves who can appraise it.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Do not expect it to fool thieves who can appraise it.

cues.text: Even if they see through it… the family waiting here is real.
cues.line: [Mimi|Happy]: Even if they see through it… the family waiting here is real.

cues.text: After the lure ends, we make time for you to rest too.
cues.line: [Lumi|Smiling]: After the lure ends, we make time for you to rest too.

cues.text: Only the treasure is false. The protection behind it is real.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Only the treasure is false. The protection behind it is real.

cues.text: Thread across the bridge should keep them out of my water, you know.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Firm]: Thread across the bridge should keep them out of my water, you know.

cues.text: I will leave room for your tongue.
cues.line: [Silky|Firm]: I will leave room for your tongue.

cues.text: I will complain if you stitch the tongue too, you know.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Firm]: I will complain if you stitch the tongue too, you know.

cues.text: Enemy feet, not tongue. Family route stays clear.
cues.line: [Silky|Smiling]: Enemy feet, not tongue. Family route stays clear.

cues.text: A joint defense of pond and sewing room. Reassuring already.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: A joint defense of pond and sewing room. Reassuring already.

cues.text: Joint management still leaves my return demand valid, you know.
cues.line: [Pongdang|Deadpan]: Joint management still leaves my return demand valid, you know.

cues.text: I will… first… on the path…
cues.line: [Neurit|Determined]: I will… first… on the path…

cues.text: Yes. No fire until you finish speaking.
cues.line: [Pynn|Determined]: Yes. No fire until you finish speaking.

cues.text: Leave a trail… then… move clear…
cues.line: [Neurit|Determined]: Leave a trail… then… move clear…

cues.text: Good. I heat it after your shell is clear.
cues.line: [Pynn|Smiling]: Good. I heat it after your shell is clear.

cues.text: The more urgent it is, the more we hear Neurit to the end. I will remember.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: The more urgent it is, the more we hear Neurit to the end. I will remember.

cues.text: There is… fire… that waits… too…
cues.line: [Neurit|Smiling]: There is… fire… that waits… too…

cues.text: What if a thief crosses carrying coins?
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Earnest]: What if a thief crosses carrying coins?

cues.text: Gob brings back! Ours already, not stealing!
cues.line: [Gob|Confident]: Gob brings back! Ours already, not stealing!

cues.text: Then I block the front. Hear the crossing reason first!
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Earnest]: Then I block the front. Hear the crossing reason first!

cues.text: Running away request rejected!
cues.line: [Gob|Pleased]: Running away request rejected!

cues.text: Recovered coins get their own tally. Do not count them twice as tolls.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Recovered coins get their own tally. Do not count them twice as tolls.

cues.text: Work and a ledger too. I can stay a long time, right?
cues.line: [Beongbeong|Moved]: Work and a ledger too. I can stay a long time, right?

cues.text: If you shine light… they might see me…
cues.line: [Shh|Whispering]: If you shine light… they might see me…

cues.text: Not lighting you. Choosing who we watch.
cues.line: [Lumi|Firm]: Not lighting you. Choosing who we watch.

cues.text: Then behind them… I say peekaboo…?
cues.line: [Shh|Whispering]: Then behind them… I say peekaboo…?

cues.text: Yes. Afterward, follow the return mark I leave.
cues.line: [Lumi|Smiling]: Yes. Afterward, follow the return mark I leave.

cues.text: Longer instructions for returning than ambushing. Excellent.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Longer instructions for returning than ambushing. Excellent.

cues.text: A light that finds me… is not scary…
cues.line: [Shh|Whispering]: A light that finds me… is not scary…

cues.text: This plate is my body. Can I lend it?
cues.line: [Teongteong|Firm]: This plate is my body. Can I lend it?

cues.text: While bracing family. Get it back. Tok.
cues.line: [Toktok|Firm]: While bracing family. Get it back. Tok.

cues.text: A righteous loan! Though a bigger gap is a little frightening.
cues.line: [Teongteong|Flustered]: A righteous loan! Though a bigger gap is a little frightening.

cues.text: I brace the gap. Taking turns.
cues.line: [Toktok|Pleased]: I brace the gap. Taking turns.

cues.text: Moving a plate does not reduce the family you must protect.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Moving a plate does not reduce the family you must protect.

cues.text: Then I leave my name inside the plate. A place to return to.
cues.line: [Teongteong|Flustered]: Then I leave my name inside the plate. A place to return to.

cues.text: My flame can stand up to Selen's light, right?!
cues.line: [Noknok|Screaming]: My flame can stand up to Selen's light, right?!

cues.text: Avoid your drips first. Ember talk afterward.
cues.line: [Pynn|Determined]: Avoid your drips first. Ember talk afterward.

cues.text: Another flame beside me might mean less screaming!
cues.line: [Noknok|Screaming]: Another flame beside me might mean less screaming!

cues.text: Use that extra breath to watch our side's feet.
cues.line: [Pynn|Smiling]: Use that extra breath to watch our side's feet.

cues.text: Our lighting meetings always get loud.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Our lighting meetings always get loud.

cues.text: Not terror effects. Professional enthusiasm!
cues.line: [Noknok|Happy]: Not terror effects. Professional enthusiasm!

cues.text: Even by tunnel, check the arrival point first. Dolkong, please!
cues.line: [Papa|Firm]: Even by tunnel, check the arrival point first. Dolkong, please!

cues.text: Space beside me clear. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Firm]: Space beside me clear. Kong.

cues.text: Family needs space to emerge. Holding the entrance is rescue too.
cues.line: [Papa|Firm]: Family needs space to emerge. Holding the entrance is rescue too.

cues.text: Leave the surface road too. Kong.
cues.line: [Dolkong|Moved]: Leave the surface road too. Kong.

cues.text: Our return order comes before Roman's construction order.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Boastful]: Our return order comes before Roman's construction order.

cues.text: Completion stamp after everyone is out!
cues.line: [Papa|Proud]: Completion stamp after everyone is out!

cues.text: Send Milo left-right to the third throne!
cues.line: [Kkogit|Flustered]: Send Milo left-right to the third throne!

cues.text: False footprints that way too. Family marks separate.
cues.line: [Rolo|Determined]: False footprints that way too. Family marks separate.

cues.text: Wrong on purpose this time! Double confidence!
cues.line: [Kkogit|Flustered]: Wrong on purpose this time! Double confidence!

cues.text: Then I will check the real way home once more.
cues.line: [Rolo|Smiling]: Then I will check the real way home once more.

cues.text: Lost family means a rescue request, not an operation report.
cues.line: [Bati|Dry]: Lost family means a rescue request, not an operation report.

cues.text: Got it! No folding the inside map!
cues.line: [Kkogit|Proud]: Got it! No folding the inside map!

cues.text: Cheese to lure Nia or feed us? Important motion!
cues.line: [Jjikjjik Union|Firm]: Cheese to lure Nia or feed us? Important motion!

cues.text: Lure is fake… yours is separate…
cues.line: [Mimi|Flustered]: Lure is fake… yours is separate…

cues.text: Separate real from fake! Unanimous!
cues.line: [Jjikjjik Union|Firm]: Separate real from fake! Unanimous!

cues.text: When they open the chest… tell me so I do not get startled first.
cues.line: [Mimi|Happy]: When they open the chest… tell me so I do not get startled first.

cues.text: Let us confirm no real coin budget goes into fake treasure.
cues.line: [Goldin|Calculating]: Let us confirm no real coin budget goes into fake treasure.

cues.text: Recovery team on duty! Cheese after shift!
cues.line: [Jjikjjik Union|Pleased]: Recovery team on duty! Cheese after shift!

cues.text: Mama pulls them clear, I take the pain.
cues.line: [Nubi|Earnest]: Mama pulls them clear, I take the pain.

cues.text: You need not take all of it. I pull them so they get hurt less.
cues.line: [Silky|Firm]: You need not take all of it. I pull them so they get hurt less.

cues.text: Then only as far as the thread reaches. So it will not break.
cues.line: [Nubi|Earnest]: Then only as far as the thread reaches. So it will not break.

cues.text: I will check your stitches too. You are included in the rescue.
cues.line: [Silky|Smiling]: I will check your stitches too. You are included in the rescue.

cues.text: The combination includes staying with the one who takes the pain.
cues.line: [Demon Lord|Determined]: The combination includes staying with the one who takes the pain.

cues.text: Then this curse is not scary. We are tied together.
cues.line: [Nubi|Smiling]: Then this curse is not scary. We are tied together.
